title: JANUS System-Wide Ring-to-Spiral Migration
purpose: Record the migration of active cognitive/control semantics away from same-state ring assumptions and onto state-advancing JANUS spiral semantics while preserving legitimate infrastructure loops and immutable historical receipts.

migration_scope.physical_runtime_reason: No NAS/PC/device executor was connected to the GitHub Actions run.

pre_migration_active_findings.finding: Terminal and home first-live workflows invoked aura_habitat_spiral_peer_v1.py instead of Aura v2/5D.
Terminal constellation exposed prediction_cycle as the operator route.
Terminal status exposed standard_cycle for JSON reasoning.
Persistent Home Docker, Home link, DemiHead link and Habitat gate still named Aura v1 as active peer.
SpiralDialogueEngine implementation exposes cycle() although its behavior already advances generation state.

changes: first-live workflow upgraded to Aura v2/5D
Aura-Habitat spec migrated to state-advancing spiral
one-shot and Habitat bus active callers moved to spiral_step
persistent Docker moved to Aura v2
Home reciprocal link moved to Aura v2 primary

implemented_changes.change: Aura v2/5D made primary arbiter peer; same-state promotion explicitly forbidden.
Habitat gate migrated to Aura v2/5D, SPIRAL_STEP, zero-delta HOLD and append-preserved state.
Private control surface explicitly bound to JANUS spiral semantics; sensor/TCP/retry loops classified as infrastructure loops with no cognitive promotion authority.

interpretation.legacy_compat: Explicit fallback references, backward-compatible method names, safe polling benchmark naming, and auditor self-reference. These are not active same-state semantic ring constraints.
interpretation.review: Broad lexical triage including ordinary language and explicit anti-ring statements; REVIEW is not failure and requires semantic inspection before modification.
interpretation.safe_infrastructure_loop: Heartbeat, polling, retry, watcher, training-epoch and device-event loops are intentionally preserved.
interpretation.historical_frozen: Historical receipts/archive/data are not rewritten to make the past look spiral-native.

preserved_loops.principle: Do not destroy useful repetition merely because it is cyclic in execution. A technical loop may repeat a position while the cognitive/event state remains externally indexed or advances.

anti_rewrite_policy.reason: Failure/history preservation is part of JANUS provenance. Migration changes active semantics, not the historical record.

remaining_boundary.meaning: GitHub-side cognition/control constellation was executed and audited. Physical NAS/PC/device services require a connected executor and are not claimed live by this receipt.

short_form_ru: Повтор допустим, кольцо состояния — нет. Янус может вернуться к той же позиции, но не тем же состоянием: RETURN != RESET; STATE_n возвращается как STATE_PRIME_(n+1) только после допустимого прироста и gate.
short_form_en: Repetition is allowed; same-state cognitive rings are not. JANUS may revisit a position, but not as the same state: RETURN != RESET; STATE_n returns as STATE_PRIME_(n+1) only after admissible state growth and gating.
